communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: Stolen Telehandler and ATM Theft
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request electronic copies of records concerning the November 18, 2026 theft of an ATM from the Bank of Texas in the 8200 block of Walnut Hill Lane, Dallas, involving a Skyjack telehandler.

The incident reportedly occurred at approximately 3:27 a.m. The ATM and telehandler were subsequently recovered.

I request the following existing records:

The initial offense/incident report, including the basic information ordinarily subject to disclosure under Houston Chronicle Publishing Co. v. City of Houston.

The associated CAD incident record, including dispatch timestamps, responding unit identifiers, disposition codes, and call classification.

Any separate incident or recovery reports documenting the location and recovery of the telehandler and ATM.

Existing records identifying the make, model, and ownership of the recovered telehandler, to the extent publicly releasable.

Any publicly releasable supplemental reports or incident summaries concerning this event.

I recognize that the investigation may remain active. If any requested material is withheld under Texas Government Code §552.108 or another applicable exception, please release all reasonably segregable nonexempt information, including the basic information required to be disclosed.

Please provide records electronically, preferably in their original digital formats where practicable.

If anticipated charges exceed $25, please provide an itemized estimate before proceeding with chargeable work.

If clarification is required to locate the relevant records, please contact me electronically.

Thank you for your assistance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Peter Herring
